children: ICICI Securities's research report on Bharat Forge

Bharat Forge (BHFC)’s consol. EBITDAM was a tad below our estimate due to higher inflationary costs. Management commentary on its growth outlook remains strong. Recovery in Class-8 truck demand and healthy momentum in the domestic CV segment are expected to support growth. We believe medium–long-term prospects remain compelling, aided by a growing order book (OB) in newer verticals like defence, semicon and aerospace. Upcoming capacity expansions, backed by order wins, are expected drive medium-term growth. Key monitorables include improvement in profitability of overseas
subsidiaries and timely execution of defence orders.
We fine-tune our FY27/28E EBITDA by 1-2%. A sharper cut in EPS is due to higher-than-expected tax-rate. Retain BUY; TP revised to INR 2,150 (vs. INR 2,250), basis 40x Sep’28E EPS
